A '''prismatic crystal housing''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component.<ref name="CRFG" /> It held the weapon's [[Prismatic crystal/Legends|prismatic crystal]], which focused the energy beam released from the weapon's [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]]. The beam passed into the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the weapon where it was further focused by [[Galven circuit/Legends|galven circuitry]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The entire housing could be removed and replaced using a [[prismatic crystal aligner]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
